subject: Re: HD-4471 — WC-12 credential handoff
body:
4/5 — the rep was polite, but please actually check my account this time before replying — don't just go off my say-so. Last time the Wi-Fi field was described as a ""ask IT and it will resolve" line" and it didn't — the packet stayed incomplete and the packet scanner ended up needing the reference that sits on the account's review file, case the WC-12 onboarding record. Please pull the WC-12 onboarding record against this packet so you're not repeating the old mistake.

the packet scanner asked me to have support list the reference types on file for the WC-12 onboarding record so they can map the hold to the right one. Please pull the WC-12 onboarding record and include the case's reference option list in the the onboarding ticket HD-4471 reply — all the listed reference labels, exactly as stored — so the packet scanner can identify which applies.
